text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Onee-chan? Tell me already~.
Where are we? 
What are we doing today~?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To return the favor for the reward you 
gave us earlier. Here's a present for you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~! So many dresses!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I thought we could wear them and have a 
photoshoot. You love sparkling things, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Yeah! My heart is pounding~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad. Well then, go get ready, 
okay? We'll be waiting outside.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Waaaah~ Such a special dress♪ I'm 
super-duper sparkly right now♡)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~…… But since we're doing this, it 
shouldn't be just by myself~……

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Those outfits……!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Your real reward is us,
your big sisters…… 
just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez,
you two are way too amazing♡ How did 
you know what I wanted?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. We're your big sisters after all, 
this is nothing. Right, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I just came because it's a return gift 
for the other day, that's all……

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Look at you saying that~…… Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I love you♡ I love you,
Onee-chans♡ I love 
you so, so much~~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, shall we go then? To let them 
photograph how harmonious we are.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then, then~ How about this for the next 
pose?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Snuggling up right against Cheval-chi's 
shoulder♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-You don't have to stick that close……

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just give up,
Cheval. Today is about 
returning the favor to Vivlos, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Besides~ even if you act 
shy, your feelings come right through♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I know you two big sisters love me so, so 
much too♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in the cafeteria,
I spotted Vivlos 
happily staring at her smartphone in high 
spirits.
choice_data_list: You look pretty happy. What are yo...
You look pretty happy. What are yo...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Photos♪ I took them with my sisters! They 
turned out super photogenic. Look, look!
choice_data_list: You look happy. What are you looki...
You look happy. What are you looki...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Photos♪ I took them with my sisters! They 
turned out super photogenic. Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right? We took solo ones too. Like this 
one, Onee-chan looks so pretty, just like 
a queen, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chi was super stiff, so I made her 
laugh with a funny dance……

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then it cracked her up so much she 
couldn't stop laughing. Ahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
But~ the best shot is definitely♪ The one 
with all three of us!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because every single one of us— has the 
very best smile on♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup! We're super close♪ Or actually,
maybe 
even beyond just 'close'!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We understand everything about each
other! 
Things we like, things we hate,
right? And 
even kinda what the others are thinking.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ That might be just a tiny bit off, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —It's *our* sisterhood that's amazing♡
